name: China Valley Restaurant
why_it_matters: Ranked #1 of Pasighat's TripAdvisor restaurants (4.7) — the Chinese/pan-Asian kitchen that East Siang residents and visitors converge on. 3.7 across 315 Justdial reviews. Located near Punjab National Bank in the main market.
insider_tip: Cosy place, fills up fast for dinner — call ahead after 7pm. The Chinese end of the menu is what built the reputation; the Tibetan section is competent but unremarkable.
signature_address: Near Punjab National Bank, Main Market, Pasighat, East Siang, Arunachal Pradesh 791102

name: Naga Kitchen
why_it_matters: One of the few Pasighat kitchens serving a proper Adi tribal thali alongside Naga and Manipuri dishes — pork curry, king chilli chutney, fermented bamboo (eromba). Located near the Rural Bank in Ering complex. Home delivery available.
insider_tip: King chilli chutney is no joke — ask for a smaller portion if you haven't built tolerance. The Adi thali is the order to make; the Naga side of the menu is for repeat visits.
signature_address: Near Rural Bank, Ering Complex, Pasighat, East Siang, Arunachal Pradesh 791102

name: Moody Bliss Restaurant & Lounge
why_it_matters: Multi-cuisine sit-down + lounge above Punjab National Bank in Pasighat's main market — broader menu and bar make it the default group-dining choice when the table mixes vegetarians and meat-eaters. Rare in Pasighat to have a lounge format.
insider_tip: Stick to the chilli prawns and Indo-Chinese — the Continental section is ambitious but inconsistent. Lounge stays open later than the kitchen on most nights.
signature_address: Above PNB, Main Market, Pasighat, East Siang, Arunachal Pradesh 791102

name: The Bogong Kitchen
why_it_matters: Local Pasighat kitchen cited for cooking real Arunachal food with fresh local ingredients — starters, mains, and Adi favourites. Listed on Justdial Pasighat restaurant index. Smaller and quieter than Naga Kitchen, but in the same Adi-cuisine bracket.
insider_tip: Operating hours are owner-set and can shift — call before going. Cash preferred; UPI works when network is up.
